## Life up until now
I grew up in Toronto and went to UWaterloo for undergrad like many other people. The summer after graduation was the only break I had before transitioning into the master's program. Before that, I mainly worked in multiple internships within the fintech industry.

## Why Master's?
It was actually my previous internships that first sparked my interest in data science. Working with a lot of financial data, it really drove home that data is the underlying factor of everything. I wanted to learn more about how I can create with data. Also, it wouldn't hurt to try to experience a new life in Vancouver. 

## Outside of Academics and Careers
On a normal day, I'd probably jump at any opportunity to play volleyball. However, it's not sustainable to play every day so I end up working out more often. Otherwise, my life is simple: a black iced coffee, good food, good company and the occasional scenic nature walk.
